strips.title: A walk with Noeul — the three things in the bag

panels.head: 4:58 p.m. — the window shift
panels.text: A Jindo keeps time. The stare at the door starts two minutes before the walk, every day, without an app.

panels.head: Harness on, two fingers
panels.text: Over the head, two clicks, two fingers under the girth strap. Front ring today: the park is that way.

panels.head: The sniff, the deed, the flip
panels.text: Hand inside the bag, grab, invert, knot. Sixty a month: the bag is the product that must not fail.

panels.head: 8 p.m. — the frozen KONG
panels.text: Dinner went into the KONG at noon and into the freezer. Thirty quiet minutes; the couch survives another evening.

strips.title: The same cart, three stores — what owners describe in 2026

panels.head: Amazon, day 1
panels.text: Sold-by line reads KONG. Red rubber, the logo, two openings. Stuffed and frozen by dinner.

panels.head: Walmart, day 3
panels.text: A rollback ball for less than the pet shop charges. Sold and shipped by Walmart, not the marketplace beside it.

panels.head: Temu, day 9
panels.text: A red look-alike: no logo, one hole, 3 to 15 days later. Temu has no genuine KONG, Chuckit! or Earth Rated.

panels.head: Day 10 — the return
panels.text: Amazon: 30 days, drop it at a store. Chewy: 365 days and "keep it". Temu: one free label per order, then $7.99 each.
